facebook.caption:
POV: you're on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo, sweaty, over-stimulated, and a French bakery appears out of nowhere.

O BON PAIN-FRENCH BAKERY on Phú Quốc. 4.3 stars. 360 reviews. The croissants are real. The AC is real. The reset is real.

When every other stop is fried seafood and cold beer, this place hits different. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
